summary: The c7 labeling bug is fixed and now empirically proven rather than merely build-verified: the generator passed record 13,750 -- the point that defeated 3/3 prior attempts -- and reached 124,235 records with RSS pinned flat at ~1.70GB across a 40-minute window, against an original failure signature of unbounded ~40MB/6s growth. The July compile blocker is gone permanently (Formula.c 162s, FormulaEnumerator.c 384s, both cached). One real build-blocking defect was found and fixed: a fourth FrameClass constructor (.Dedekind) had left frameClassName in DatasetExport.lean non-exhaustive. Phase 4's full regeneration is running unattended and needs ~9 more hours.
